Nephilim.why: Scoring as both colors measured 1.31 to 1.42 (V45): it now scores 1 on any won Day

Twilight.text: At the end of the Day: If the other cards in your Choir hold as many Light cards as Dark cards (at least 1 each), gain 3 Glory.
Twilight.why: Stays Neutral (it is the in-between), so it never scores at the Reaping: 3 Glory instead of 2 (V45)

Uriel.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir has 3 or more other Light cards, gain 1 Glory.
Uriel.why: With a mostly colored deck a full Light Choir is common: 1.29 to 1.41 at 2 Glory (V45)

Beelzebub.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir has 3 or more other Dark cards, gain 1 Glory.

Hubris.text: At the end of the Day: If the player with the most Glory gained 8 or more Glory this Day, they give 1 to you.

Moloch.text: On your turn: You may discard 1 other Host card from your Choir to gain 2 Glory. Its ability must not have been used this turn.
Moloch.why: A Choir card now scores every Day its color wins, so giving one up is dearer: 0.64 at 1 Glory (V45)

The Tempest.text: When you Offer, you may destroy a card on the Altar, face up or facedown.
The Tempest.why: 0.80 to 0.89 when it could only destroy face-up cards (V45)

The Eclipse.text: In the Evening, before the Altar is revealed: Choose a Light or Dark card in your Choir. It counts as the other color at this Day's Reaping.
The Eclipse.why: Counting as both measured 1.43 to 1.64 (V45): now a guess made before the reveal

The Cantor.text: When you Offer a card, you may Offer a second card with it. Both go facedown, and they count as one Offer.
The Cantor.why: 0.75 to 0.77 with matching pairs face up (V45): now a bigger, hidden push

The Patron.text: On your turn: Exchange a card from your hand with a card in another player's Choir.
The Patron.why: Giving a card now always helps its receiver (V45; 0.61 to 0.78): the Patron now takes one in exchange

The Whisper.text: In the Morning: Name Light or Dark aloud. If that side wins the Day, gain 2 Glory; if the other side wins, lose 1.
The Whisper.why: Making every card score measured 1.73 to 1.96 (V45)

The Arbiter.text: When your Choir scores at the Reaping, take 1 of that Glory from another player whose Choir scored less.
The Arbiter.why: Few Choirs score nothing in a colored deck (V45; 0.72 to 0.81)
